visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and a young girl wearing a black "MERRILLY" cap and a green military-style jacket stand in a brightly lit supermarket aisle. The girl holds up a plastic ID badge with colorful cartoon graphics and the text "拯救母雞大作戰". (2) The scene cuts to a group of about 30 children sitting on small stools in a designated activity area inside the store. A woman in pink overalls and a red headpiece speaks into a microphone while standing near a TV screen displaying a rainbow landscape background. (3) The young girl interacts with the host and receives a colorful sticker sheet featuring bird characters. Digital overlays and logos for "Mama Daddy Story" and Carrefour appear frequently on the screen. (4) Performers dressed in yellow chicken costumes and a brown animal mascot suit dance and act on a small stage while holding handheld microphones for the children. (5) The girl navigates through the supermarket aisles, carefully inspecting and pointing at specific packages of lettuce and cartons of eggs on refrigerated shelves. She smiles at the camera while showing the product labels. (6) A large red and white bird mascot named "Pai Pai" dances in front of the seated crowd of children. The girl is seen dancing and clapping along with the mascot in a wide-angle shot of the room. (7) Finally, the girl and woman return to a medium close-up shot, with the girl holding a brown egg. They talk directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures, appearing to summarize their experience.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Bright and rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming begins instantly as an enthusiastic female voice asks a high-pitched question. The speech is very clear and energetic. (2) A loud sequence of handclaps and cheering follows a rhythmic countdown. A woman's voice amplified through a microphone speaker dominates the mix with high vocal arousal and dramatic rising intonation. (3) A digital 'whoosh' transition effect triggers a new phase featuring a professional male narrator with a warm, lower-pitched voice explaining mission details. The background music maintains a steady, upbeat drum beat. (4) A percussive pop jingle starts with synthesized vocal lines. The sound of children laughing and cheering is layered clearly over the rhythmic music. (5) The acoustic guitar returns as the main background bed while the original woman and child voices have a clear conversational dialogue. The speech rate is moderate and the tone is joyful and satisfied.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Challenge Setup -> Event Highlights -> Successful Mission Execution -> Reflection and CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote an educational and interactive family event at Carrefour supermarkets held in collaboration with the 'Mama Daddy Story' app. The video aims to teach children about ethical food sourcing, such as cage-free eggs, through games, storytelling, and practical shopping challenges.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly features Carrefour branding, employees, and products, along with a direct call to download and listen to the 'Mama Daddy Story' podcast app.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines vlog-style storytelling with high-production event coverage to drive brand engagement for both the supermarket and the media platform.
